info.description: The chrome that wraps a rendered page. A page shell carries no page content of its own.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Name
edit.description: How this page shell is named in this list. Visitors never see it.

edit.label: Default page shell
edit.description: New entries adopt whichever page shell is marked default. Marking this one demotes the one that held it.

edit.label: Site title
edit.description: Shown in the header and used as the browser tab's title.

edit.label: Site description
edit.description: A sentence describing the site, used where no page supplies its own.

edit.label: Header navigation
edit.description: The links across the top of every page, in order.

edit.label: Footer navigation
edit.description: The links in the footer of every page, in order. At most three are shown.

edit.label: Registration form slideshow
edit.description: The pictures that cycle beside the registration form.

edit.label: Injected code
edit.description: Scripts added to every page wearing this shell. Anything put here runs in every visitor's browser.

edit.label: Instagram URL
edit.description: The festival's Instagram account, as a full address — https://www.instagram.com/…. Its icon in the footer links here and opens in a new tab. Leave it empty and the icon is not shown.

edit.label: Facebook URL
edit.description: The festival's Facebook page, as a full address — https://www.facebook.com/…. Its icon in the footer links here and opens in a new tab. Leave it empty and the icon is not shown.

edit.label: LinkedIn URL
edit.description: The festival's LinkedIn page, as a full address — https://www.linkedin.com/…. Its icon in the footer links here and opens in a new tab. Leave it empty and the icon is not shown.

edit.label: YouTube URL
edit.description: The festival's YouTube channel, as a full address — https://www.youtube.com/…. Its icon in the footer links here and opens in a new tab. Leave it empty and the icon is not shown. With all four empty, the footer shows no row of icons at all.
